title: Northernmost range, degrees latitude

source.name: Wood frog (Rana sylvatica) range vs. other North American frog species
source.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / National Park Service amphibian range data

notes: Most North American frog species range no farther north than roughly 45 degrees N. Wood frogs are the only frog documented north of the Arctic Circle (66.5 N) in North America, with populations recorded to roughly 68 degrees N in Alaska.
